text:
sam_support: FYI customer_acme opened a ticket — mid-cycle downgrade and PO on file. Their card on file attempted payment for the next billing period and was declined, but because the downgrade happened mid-cycle we now need a partial credit note. PO requires credits to reference PO-7788 and be visible on next invoice.

ryan_billing: copying in accounting. Do we have the original invoice id? We need to issue a credit note that ties to the invoice and preserves VAT lines. Also confirm whether customer wants a refund to card or apply as credit.

sam_support: they confirmed they want the credit applied to the next invoice (not a card refund) because their purchasing team requires the PO to show adjustments. they provided invoice id inv_2024_1427 and PO-7788.

maria_accounting: ok. we need the exact prorated amount and VAT breakdown. I can't compute this until we know the exact plan price delta and the proration window. can you paste the billing math?

sam_support: here's what I pulled from the account: original plan = Pro monthly $1,200.00, new plan = Standard monthly $800.00. Downgrade occurred on day 10 of a 30-day billing cycle. So customer had 20 days remaining. Prorated credit should be (Pro - Standard) * (remaining_days/total_days).

oleg_engine: logs from payments webhook show the card attempt failed: 
```
{"event":"payment.failed","invoice":"inv_2024_1428","code":"card_declined","decline_reason":"insufficient_funds","payment_method":"pm_card_visa"}
```
We also sent the invoice webhook for inv_2024_1427 earlier; both invoices are present in the system.

sam_support: math quick calc: price delta = $1200 - $800 = $400. remaining fraction = 20/30 = 0.6666667. prorated credit (net) = $400 * 0.6666667 = $266.66668 -> round to $266.67 net. VAT (20%) = $53.33. total credit = $320.00.

ryan_billing: that looks right. Important: because the original invoice showed VAT line at 20% and the customer is EU-based, credit note must replicate VAT at the same percentage. Accounting systems require the credit note to reference the invoice id and PO number. Also we need to store a metadata field for the billing system: {"po": "PO-7788", "apply_to_next": "true"}.

maria_accounting: I'll create a manual credit note in the ledger tool. Please confirm the exact payload so I can attach it to inv_2024_1427.

sam_support: suggested API payload below for transparency (we will not POST until accounting confirms):
```
POST /v1/credit_notes
{
  "invoice": "inv_2024_1427",
  "amount": 32000,    // cents -> $320.00 total (includes VAT)
  "currency": "USD",
  "reason": "prorated-downgrade",
  "metadata": {
    "po_number": "PO-7788",
    "apply_to_next_invoice": "true",
    "proration_days": "20/30",
    "delta_net_cents": "26667",
    "vat_cents": "5333"
  }
}
```

oleg_engine: small note on rounding: our credit_notes endpoint expects amount in cents and will validate that VAT lines sum to the amount. If accounting needs the net and VAT split, generate two line items: net 26667 and tax 5333. that maps to $266.67 + $53.33 = $320.00.

ryan_billing: also flagging that the attempted payment (inv_2024_1428) failed. We should void that invoice or mark it pending while credit is applied. If the customer still has a PO requirement, we should not auto-collect. I'll mark inv_2024_1428 as "on_hold_for_po" so no further retries happen.

maria_accounting: I'll create the credit note now in our ledger and attach PO-7788. After it's done I'll post the credit_note id and stub here and we can apply it to the next invoice. Expect manual entry in ~30m.

sam_support: great, pls cc customer when applied. Customer asked for a stamped credit note PDF. maria_accounting can you include a VAT breakdown in PDF? :pray:

maria_accounting: yes. will include VAT line and a reference block: "Credit for prorated downgrade — PO-7788 — inv_2024_1427". I'll upload PDF to the ticket and notify customer.

ops_bot: Reminder: create audit event -> action by maria_accounting: created_credit_note cn_2024_9001 attached_to inv_2024_1427 (metadata.po=PO-7788).

maria_accounting: done. created credit note cn_2024_9001, net_cents=26667, tax_cents=5333, total_cents=32000. PDF uploaded to the support ticket 23456. Applying to customer's next invoice as requested.

sam_support: closing loop with customer: "We applied a credit of $320.00 (incl. VAT) to your account referencing PO-7788 and invoice inv_2024_1427. A stamped credit note has been uploaded to your ticket." customer replied :thumbsup:

ryan_billing: follow-up action: billing team to check whether we need to issue a refund later if the customer later cancels the PO. Marking ticket as monitored for 60 days.

sam_support: thanks all. no engineering action required besides the webhook note from oleg. I'll leave the thread open until the customer confirms PDF acceptance. :white_check_mark:
